login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Your farm, blocks and houses in one place.
login.serverUnreachable: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.

auth.noFarm: No farm is linked to this account.

placeholder.phase2Text: This feature is part of the full AGRECT design. It will be built after the MVP.

settings.title: Settings
settings.workspaceLead: Choose which part of the farm AGRECT shows. AGRECT opens in the last workspace you used.
settings.openFieldText: Blocks, weather, soil and water, growth stages.
settings.greenhouseText: Houses, climate, irrigation, plants, plans and team.
settings.footnote: Only workspaces your farm uses are shown. A farm with one workspace never sees this choice.

blocks.drawHint: Click the corners of the block, then draw one line along a row to set the planting direction.
blocks.emptyText: Outline it on the satellite map, then describe what is planted and how it is irrigated.
blocks.stagesText: Every block's stage now and the next one predicted
blocks.name: Block name
blocks.netHelp: Without roads and headlands. Yields in kg/ha use this area.
blocks.grossTip: Calculated by the server from the outline
blocks.noLocation: This farm has no map location yet.
blocks.spacingHelp: Type any two. The third is calculated.
blocks.addPlantingHelp: For mixed varieties or pollinizer rows. Coming in phase 2.
blocks.explainerSub: Each line fills in with the numbers you enter.

treeFormula.spacing2Label: Trees in the block, rounded down

blocks.trainingSub: Systems for {{crop}}. Pick the closest one.
blocks.trainingNone: No training system for this crop.
blocks.noCrop: Choose a crop on the planting step first.
blocks.rowSpacingNeeded: Row spacing from step 2 is needed for this calculation.
blocks.flowMeterHelp: With a meter, the measured flow replaces the calculated one.

flowFormula.footnote: A flow meter on the block replaces this value with the measured flow.

blocks.mapSplitLater: Splitting on the map comes in phase 2.
blocks.valvesIntro: Each valve is opened and closed as one unit. Start with one valve and split the block if it has more.
blocks.rowsHelp: Count the rows in the block. You can correct it later.
blocks.valveFlowSum: Block flow = sum of the valves

missing.netArea: The net planted area is missing.
missing.name: The block name is missing.
missing.rows: The number of rows is missing.

blocks.setupLead: What is planted and how it is irrigated
blocks.flowSourceCalculated: Calculated from the irrigation layout until a flow meter sends data.
blocks.flowSourceMeter: A flow meter is set for this block. Measured flow will replace the calculated one when it sends data.
blocks.historyLead: Changes to spacing, layout, valves or pump are kept with their date and reason.

errors.nameTaken: A block with this name already exists.
errors.netPositive: Enter a net area greater than 0.
errors.netExceedsGross: Net area cannot be larger than the gross area.
errors.outlineInvalid: The outline is not a valid block shape.
errors.rowLineInvalid: The row line is not a valid line.
errors.rowLineOutside: The row line must cross the block outline.
errors.version: This block was changed somewhere else. Reload and try again.
errors.whole: Enter a whole number greater than 0.
errors.cropNotFound: That crop is not in the catalogue.
errors.varietyNotFound: That variety is not in the catalogue.
errors.trainingMismatch: That training system does not match the crop.
errors.reasonRequired: Enter the reason for the change.
errors.valveRowsInvalid: Those rows are outside the block.

weather.title: Weather
weather.bannerEstimated: Estimated values from the Open-Meteo weather service for your farm location. Updated at {{time}}.
weather.bannerStale: Weather service unreachable. Showing the last values from {{time}}.
weather.sourceBody: Weather service (Open-Meteo) at your farm location ({{lat}}, {{lon}}). Values are labelled Estimated. Connecting your own station comes in phase 2.
weather.degreeSub: Totals per crop since your start date
weather.emptyText: Choose a crop, its base temperature and a start date. Each crop counts with its own base.
weather.formulaSine: Single sine, horizontal cutoff — UC IPM / Zalom et al. 1983
weather.methodHelp: Compare a total only with a reference made by the same method.
weather.emptyHelp: Leave a field empty and it is not counted.

errors.baseRange: Base temperature must be between −5 and 20 °C.
errors.upperAbove: Upper threshold must be above the base temperature.
errors.upperRange: Upper threshold must be 45 °C or less.
errors.frostRange: Frost threshold must be between −10 and 10 °C.
errors.heatRange: Heat threshold must be between 25 and 50 °C.
errors.vpdRange: VPD limit must be between 0 and 10 kPa.

today.weatherSub: Weather service for your farm location
today.stale: Weather service unreachable. Last values from {{time}}.
today.alertsSub: Forecast frost and heat warnings from your thresholds
today.noWarnings: No frost or heat in the next 7 days
today.blocksSub: Every block, its numbers and its degree days
today.emptyText: Draw your first block on the satellite map, then say what is planted and how it is irrigated.

soil.title: Soil and water
soil.bannerSoilText: Add the soil texture and root depth to see how much water is left.
soil.bannerSettingsText: Add the crop coefficient and system efficiency to see what to apply.
soil.waterLeftLine: {{left}} mm of {{taw}} mm the soil holds
soil.assumedFull: The daily balance starts at field capacity on {{date}}.
soil.restartedFull: The daily balance restarted at field capacity on {{date}}.
soil.runTime: Run time {{hours}} h {{minutes}} min at the block's rate
soil.refillOther: To refill the root zone: apply {{gross}} mm ({{hours}} h {{minutes}} min)
soil.maintainOther: To replace today's use: apply {{gross}} mm ({{hours}} h {{minutes}} min)
soil.formula: apply = crop use ÷ efficiency; run time = apply ÷ application rate
soil.logText: Every irrigation with its run time, mm and m³
soil.balanceText: Day by day: crop use, rain, irrigation, soil water
soil.checkText: Corrects the estimate when it drifts from what you feel in the field
soil.textureHelp: Use this when you have no lab result. Values are typical for the class.
soil.percentNote: Water held by % is calculated in a later version (Saxton & Rawls 2006).
soil.rootHelp: Change it to what you see in the field.
soil.dryHelp: Share of the stored water the crop can use before it is stressed (FAO-56).
soil.fullHelp: A day after a heavy irrigation or rain. The daily balance starts here.
soil.moreHelp: Skip this if you don't know. It improves the estimate but never blocks saving.
soil.rateHelp: Used to warn when water is applied faster than the soil can absorb it.
soil.efficiencyHelp: Above 0 and at most 1: the share of applied water that reaches the roots.
soil.applyBox: Water to apply = crop water use ÷ efficiency
soil.applyBoxHelp: The difference is lost to evaporation, drift, runoff or drainage.
soil.stageHelp: Growth stages will set this automatically.
soil.kcHelp: From FAO-56 Table 12 for your crop and stage. You can change it.
soil.howCropHelp: ET₀ from weather, Kc as entered
soil.howApplyHelp: Rounded to the run time at the block's rate
soil.logEmptyText: Each entry shows date, valves, run time, mm and m³
soil.deleteText: The daily balance is recalculated from that day.
soil.noValves: This block has no valves yet.
soil.flowNote: From the run time and the valve flow in the block setup. A flow meter replaces this with the measured volume.
soil.chartSub: Crop use, rain and irrigation against what the soil holds
soil.howSoilToday: Soil water today = yesterday − crop use + rain + irrigation × efficiency
soil.howDrain: Never more than the soil holds — extra water drains below the roots and is counted as lost
soil.howSoon: "Irrigate soon" — when the allowable dry-down is used up
soil.feelDryHelp: Crumbles, no moisture on the hand
soil.feelSlightHelp: Forms a weak ball that breaks easily
soil.feelMoistHelp: Forms a ball, leaves a wet mark
soil.resetLine: Soil water is reset to {{left}} mm ({{pct}} % of what the soil holds)
soil.resetNote: The daily balance continues from this value, marked Entered.

errors.fullOnRequired: Choose the day the soil was full.
errors.reasonRequired: Enter the reason for the change.
errors.rootRange: Root depth must be between 0.1 and 3 m.
errors.dryRange: Allowable dry-down must be between 10 and 90 %.
errors.percentSum: Sand, silt and clay must add up to 100.
errors.textureMissing: That texture class is not in the catalogue.
errors.efficiencyRange: Efficiency must be above 0 and at most 1.
errors.kcRange: Crop coefficient must be between 0.1 and 1.5.
errors.conflict: This was changed elsewhere. Save again to keep your values.
errors.blockNotReady: Add the valve flow and system efficiency before logging an irrigation.
errors.valveMissing: That valve is not on this block.
errors.tawMissing: Set up the soil before checking by feel.
